sc: Day-2 pustules on red skin, well baby, smear full of eosinophils → Erythema toxicum: reassure
Term baby, no meconium at 48 h, abdominal distension → Hirschsprung disease or imperforate anus
Cyanosis at rest that improves when crying, NG tube will not pass → Choanal atresia
f: Neonatal period 28 days · preterm < 37 wk · LBW < 2500 g · SGA < 10th centile for gestation
RR 40–60/min · HR 110–160 · weight loss up to 10%, back to birth weight by 10–14 days · meconium by 48 h, urine by 24 h
Erythema toxicum, milia, Mongolian spot, breast swelling, vaginal bleeding (hormones), acrocyanosis, physiological jaundice
Sacral dimple (spinal ultrasound) · absent red reflex (cataract) · port-wine stain on the forehead (Sturge–Weber) · jaundice < 24 h
Dry, skin-to-skin, breastfeed within 1 hour · cord care · vitamin K 1 mg IM · eye ointment · BCG, OPV0, hepatitis B
Not feeding · convulsions · RR ≥ 60 · severe chest indrawing · T ≥ 37.5 or < 35.5 °C · moves only when stimulated
trap: Breast swelling in a newborn: do not squeeze (mastitis) · the parachute reflex is not present at birth (appears ~8 months) · pulse oximetry of hand and foot screens for critical heart disease
